headline: 動物紀錄片點名氣候危機
context: 英國ITV的新自然紀錄片《Force of Nature》用動物的視角呈現極端氣候的衝擊，拍得很像災難片。同一天，另一部紀錄片《The Phantom Pain of Rojava》講述敘利亞羅賈瓦（Rojava）戰爭倖存者的故事，記錄退伍軍人的傷痛與重建。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Cheetahs forced to cross roiling rivers, owls battered by storms … the tone of this look at how extreme weather affects animals is all a bit disaster movie. Subtle, it is not You have a thick neck and poorly defined calf muscles and you live in South Dakota with your feckless partner and your five expressionless children. You are an owl. Your days consist of lengthy stretches of nothing, punctuated by sudden bursts of unimaginable terror. Coyotes, badgers and snakes are all bent on reducing your beak to marmalade. But it’s the weather that poses the biggest threat. Specifically, shouts Force of Nature, it’s the “MONSTER STORMS” that rumble ominously across the prairies, each of which forces you and your family to scurry into your burrow, whereupon you will stand with your trembling backs to the wall, legs wide apart and fluffy britches a-flap, like anxious viscounts in the court of Charles II. Will you survive? Or will you be eviscerated by the “ cluster bombs of tornadoes ” that churn with increasing frequency through the midwest? Continue reading...

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Maryam Ebrahimi’s documentary about a home for survivors of the war in northern Syria is tender, gentle and incredibly moving Speaking over footage filmed at the funeral of a female army commander, documentary-maker Maryam Ebrahimi notes that it’s the first time she has seen women carrying a coffin in the Middle East. As they move through crowd of mourners, she adds: “Their sisterhood amazes me.” Ebrahimi is talking about the women of Rojava, the Kurdish-led autonomous socialist region in northern Syria. At the cemetery, the women dig the soil with their bare hands; it is a tradition in Rojava, a final act of solidarity with their fallen sister. Ebrahimi’s tender, gentle film is about a home for injured army veterans in Rojava; most are survivors of the war against Islamic State (IS). The house is mixed genders; one of the men living there is Fadakhar, who has had both his legs amputated and is haunted at night by phantom itches and pains. Mostly, though, Ebrahimi’s gaze is drawn to the female veterans, who made headlines a decade ago for their courage on the battlefield. We learn that women started leaving their villages to fight IS in 2011 – though in truth a little more background about the history of Kurdish all-female battalions might have been helpful. thread_text:
動物紀錄片點名氣候危機

英國ITV的新自然紀錄片《Force of Nature》，用動物的視角呈現極端氣候造成的衝擊——郊狼、獾與蛇環伺的貓頭鷹一家，還得面對愈來愈頻繁的「怪獸風暴」，拍法很像災難片，評論說一點都不含蓄。

另外，紀錄片《The Phantom Pain of Rojava》講述敘利亞羅賈瓦（Rojava）戰爭倖存者的故事，記錄一群曾對抗伊斯蘭國（IS）的女性戰士與截肢退伍軍人的傷痛與重建，評論形容拍得溫柔而動人。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 7 月 27 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
英國ITV推出的新自然紀錄片《Force of Nature》，用動物的視角呈現極端氣候造成的衝擊——貓頭鷹一家要躲避郊狼、獾與蛇的威脅，還得面對愈來愈頻繁的「怪獸風暴」與龍捲風群，拍法很像災難片，評論說一點都不含蓄。

同一天，Guardian也推薦了紀錄片《The Phantom Pain of Rojava》，講述敘利亞北部庫德族自治區羅賈瓦（Rojava）戰爭倖存者的故事。片中記錄一群曾對抗伊斯蘭國（IS）的女性戰士，以及雙腿截肢、夜裡仍被幻肢痛折磨的退伍軍人，評論形容整部片拍得溫柔而動人。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 27 日發佈的報導。
voice_text:
有一部新的自然紀錄片，用動物的角度講氣候危機，拍得很像災難片。

英國一部新節目《Force of Nature》，跟著一窩貓頭鷹面對郊狼、獾和蛇的威脅，還有愈來愈頻繁的「怪獸風暴」，評論說整部片一點都不含蓄。

同一天還有一部紀錄片，講的是敘利亞北部一群戰爭倖存者的故事——曾經上戰場的女性戰士，還有截肢後仍被幻肢痛折磨的退伍軍人，評論形容拍得很溫柔、很動人。
